announcements.headline: Result of GM, Result of Tender Offer and TVR
Proposed Cancellation, Tender Offer & Notice of GM
announcements.insight: This represents a definitive exit event for public shareholders, effectively terminating the listed status of Devolver Digital following its acquisition by Embracer Group. The combination of cancellation and tender offer signals a complete delisting, removing liquidity and market exposure entirely in favor of private ownership.
